conventions.convention: Assume Countable Choice. Radial integration concerns nonnegative Borel functions, extended Lebesgue integrals, and 0·∞=0.
The cutoff scales μ, Λ and μ_R are positive inverse-length quantities; the toy-series parameter λ is dimensionless and nonnegative.
The leg set is finite and may be empty; E_i>0, |v_i|<1, η_i=-1 incoming and +1 outgoing, and Ση_iQ_i=0. Four-vector contractions use h=diag(1,-1,-1,-1).
The soft-model cutoffs satisfy 0<λ<Λ and have energy units. Length coordinates satisfy q=(ℏc)k. The energy measure is d³q/[(2π)³2|q|], while the length-coordinate measure is d³k.
Fock pairings are linear in the second variable; Ψ_λ=W(-i√2 f_λ)Ω=exp(-N_λ/2)ε(f_λ). Sector indices start at zero, and N^0=1 even for N=0.
Projective-ray distance is inf over |z|=1 of ||u-zv||, rather than its square. Infrared nonconvergence requires C>0; C=0 gives the vacuum at every cutoff.
Euler’s number is written e in upright mathematical notation and equals exp(1); it is distinct from the SI charge e.

load_bearing.statement: Under Countable Choice, the stated balanced finite massive-leg data, and the exact supplier interfaces F2 and L1, N_λ=||h_λ||²=C log(Λ/λ). The specified unitary sends h_λ to f_λ, and the normalized coherent vector has sector squared norms exp(-N_λ)N_λ^m/m!, total weight one, sector-index sum N_λ, operator-domain membership, and free-energy expectation C(Λ-λ). For C=0 it is the vacuum. For C>0, conditional on L1, it converges weakly to zero and has no strong Fock limit; its projective rays have no limit, as proved separately.

Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice. For every R>0 and nonnegative Borel φ:[0,R]→[0,∞], with extended Lebesgue integrals and 0·∞=0, the integral of φ(|x|) over the closed radius-R ball in R⁴ equals 2π² times the integral from 0 to R of φ(r)r³ dr.

Assume Countable Choice and the stated unit convention. For μ,Λ,μ_R>0, I_Λ=[Λ²-μ² log(1+Λ²/μ²)]/(16π²), and the selected subtraction tends to μ² log(μ²/μ_R²)/(16π²). For dimensionless λ≥0 and every integer N≥0, F(λ) has the displayed exact finite factorial expansion and remainder integral bounded by (N+1)!. The formal real series Σ(-1)^n n!λ^n has convergence radius zero.

seams_checked.note: L1 retains the infrared supplier’s positive angular norm, transverse L² data, finite cutoffs, operator-domain membership and weak-zero/no-strong-limit conclusions. The projective-ray obstruction is explicitly proved locally rather than attributed to that supplier.
The consumers preserve the algebraic metric h=-η, dimensionless positive coupling, SI versus inverse-length conversions and absence of a probability assignment in the mathematical conventions.

The second-variable-linear pairing, symmetric sectors, Weyl displacement sign and maximal energy domain agree with the suppliers. The theorem proves separability before applying the Weyl result and explains the scalar-to-vector multiplier restriction.

The physical consumer preserves charge balance, massive-leg hypotheses, angular normalization and energy cutoffs. Its measurable polarization identification produces a possible overall wavefunction sign, handled by a sectorwise unitary. It adds the Born interpretation through explicit physical premises and derives infrared nonconvergence from overlaps without strengthening the supplier’s conditional infrared clause.
